response.sql: WITH execution_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(remaincount) AS benchmark FROM orderexecutions), order_averages AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS order_avg FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), first_pass AS (SELECT oa.order_avg, eb.benchmark FROM order_averages oa CROSS JOIN execution_benchmark eb WHERE oa.order_avg > eb.benchmark), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(order_avg) AS benchmark FROM first_pass) SELECT AVG(fp.order_avg) AS average_unfilled_quantity, AVG(fp.order_avg - fp.benchmark) AS average_excess_over_first_benchmark, AVG(fp.order_avg - sb.benchmark) AS average_excess_over_second_benchmark FROM first_pass fp CROSS JOIN second_benchmark sb WHERE fp.order_avg > sb.benchmark;
